title: Heirship
summary: HEIRSHIP, noun areship. The state, character or privileges of an heir; right of inheriting. 1. heirship movables, in Scotland, the best of certain kinds of movables which the heir is entitled to take,

inlines.v: HEIRSHIP, noun areship. The state, character or privileges of an heir; right of inheriting. 1. heirship movables, in Scotland, the best of certain kinds of movables which the heir is entitled to take, besides the heritable estate.
